## 🔍 Quality & Verification Checklist

- [ ] **Typecheck:** `npm run typecheck` passes without errors.

- [ ] **Unit Tests:** `npm run test:unit` passes.
- [ ] **Build:** `npm run build` succeeds across all workspaces.
- [ ] **No Secrets:** Verified that no `.env`, API keys, passwords, or JWT secrets are committed.
- [ ] **Documentation Updated:** Corresponding API/Workflow docs in `docs/` updated.
- [ ] **No Breaking Changes:** Backward compatibility maintained for existing frontend integrators.
